source: AQA's key dates for A-level Law (7162), June 2027 series

alevel.name: Paper 1: Criminal law, with the nature of law and the English legal system
Paper 2: Tort, with the nature of law and the English legal system
Paper 3A: Law of contract, with the nature of law and the English legal system
Paper 3B: Human rights, with the nature of law and the English legal system

asNote: Students sit Paper 1, Paper 2 and one of Paper 3A (contract) or Paper 3B (human rights), which are timetabled together. AQA no longer offers AS Law.
